about: Hand-curated register of official 'profession de foi' PDFs used by scripts/sync-municipal-promises.mjs. One entry per commune (INSEE code), for the WINNING list of the 2026 municipal election. Only add a URL you have opened yourself and checked is the official leaflet of that list (panel number = 'Numéro de panneau' in public/data/municipal/<dept>.json). The Ministry's site programme-candidats.interieur.gouv.fr is behind a bot challenge: open it in a normal browser, copy the PDF link, and optionally save the file as .cache/municipal/pdf/<code>.pdf.

<INSEE code>.pdf: https://... (required, published as the source link)
<INSEE code>.panel: number (recommended; checked against the winning list)
<INSEE code>.round: 1 or 2 (the round the leaflet was for)
<INSEE code>.title: optional
